title: Maria and Her Brother
text:
Maria is very kind. She helps her friends with their homework. She is also funny, and she makes everyone laugh. Her brother Juan is shy. He does not talk much in class.

Juan is quiet, but he is very smart. He likes to read books about space. Maria and Juan are different, but they are good friends. They like to spend time together on Sundays.

questions.text: What does Juan like to read about?
Why is Juan probably quiet in class?
How do Maria and Juan feel about each other?
options: They do not know each other

vocabulary.definition: friendly and helpful to other people

able to learn and understand things quickly
